-- Default: create a profile_moderation record and set moderation_data based on AI result
INSERT INTO profile_moderation (profile_id, moderator_type, status, reason, moderation_data) VALUES ('{{ $json["profile_id"] }}', 'AI', '{{ $json["value"] && (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) ? JSON.parse($json["value"]).status : 'REVIEW' }}', (JSON.parse($json["value"]).reason)::text, (JSON.parse($json["value"])::jsonb));

-- Insert moderation_history entry
INSERT INTO moderation_history (profile_id, action, old_status, new_status, actor_type, actor_id, comment) VALUES ('{{ $json["profile_id"] }}', 'ai_moderation', (SELECT status FROM profiles WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}'), (CASE WHEN (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) = 'APPROVED' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) = 'REJECTED' THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE 'PENDING_MODERATION' END), 'AI', NULL, (JSON.parse($json["value"]).reason)::text);

-- Branch action: APPROVED -> set profile active
UPDATE profiles SET status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) = 'APPROVED';

-- Branch action: REJECTED -> block profile
UPDATE profiles SET status = 'BLOCKED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) = 'REJECTED';

-- Branch action: REVIEW -> set profile to PENDING_MODERATION
UPDATE profiles SET status = 'PENDING_MODERATION', updated_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND (JSON.parse($json["value"]).status) = 'REVIEW';

-- Always create audit_event
INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ((SELECT user_id FROM profiles WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}'), 'ai_moderation_finished', (JSON.parse($json["value"])::jsonb));
